contexts.text: Ephron and the Sons of Heth () = those with whom the good and truth of the Church is received.
Ephron = those with whom the good and truth of faith could be received. AC 2940. AC 2951. AC 2963. AC 6454. AC 6550. AC 6551.
Ephron is here called the Hittite to represent the Spiritual Church as head and prince.

The field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite which is upon the faces of Mamre () = resurrection as to good; and it also = the spiritual who receive truth and good from the Lord's Divine Human, and are saved.
